- TOTAL revenue reached £154.7k TW versus £145.0k LW, a WoW gain of 6.6%.
- TOTAL units came in at 103,003 TW, up 21.8% WoW, with orders at 397 TW, up 18.9% WoW.
- United Kingdom ranked 1 TW with £143.7k, holding a 92.9% share of TOTAL revenue TW.
- Channel Islands ranked 2 TW at £3.4k (2.2% share) and EIRE ranked 3 TW at £1.9k (1.2% share), with the top three at 96.4% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- France posted the steepest WoW revenue increase at +349.8%, followed by Channel Islands at +334.5% WoW.
- Switzerland fell 82.0% WoW and Germany fell 62.5% WoW.
- United Kingdom delivered the largest absolute WoW gain at £13.2k, while Switzerland recorded the largest absolute WoW decline at -£6.4k.
- United Kingdom led volume TW with 96,600 units and 382 orders, the highest of any country TW.
